title: Size-dependent metal–support interactions in Co/CeO2–Y2O3 catalysts for enhanced methane dry reforming
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10896-10901
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00007F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanhui Long, Liboting Gao, Yilin Zhang, Wee-Liat Ong, Hao Zhang, Yan Jianhua
Metal–support interactions critically influence catalytic performance, yet precise modulation remains challenging. We demonstrate that tuning support particle size effectively regulates Co–CeO2–Y2O3 interactions, enhancing methane dry reforming.
